annotations.title: Get a Stripe Checkout URL that tops up this key’s balance

description: Creates a one-time Stripe Checkout Session for a credit pack, bound to the calling live key’s account. When the payment completes the credits land on that balance; poll GET /keys/me. This is what a 402 `topUp.checkoutEndpoint` points at. Free, consumes no quota. (POST https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/credits/checkout — free; needs a connected account or a dv_sk_ key)

pack.description: Credit pack to buy, e.g. "1000". The `credits_packs` tool lists the packs on sale.
